steps.en: OCMS checks whether the owner has a mobile number or email
steps.id: OCMS mengecek apakah owner punya nomor ponsel atau email
steps.why_en: The check only runs inside the notification job at one stage, not right after the owner is found.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan hanya jalan di dalam job notifikasi pada satu tahap, bukan tepat setelah owner ditemukan.

steps.en: People are checked for a phone number, companies for an email
steps.id: Perorangan dicek nomor ponsel, perusahaan dicek email
steps.why_en: The split by person or company is not in the story and the referred epic is missing.
steps.why_id: Pembagian perorangan atau perusahaan tidak ada di story dan epic acuannya tidak tersedia.

steps.en: Contact details are refreshed from the national data source
steps.id: Kontak diperbarui dari sumber data nasional
steps.why_en: That refresh is built but switched off in every environment in the repo.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan itu sudah ada tapi dimatikan di semua environment di repo.

steps.en: The SMS or email notice is sent to the owner
steps.id: Notifikasi SMS atau email dikirim ke owner
steps.why_en: The sending is built but the scheduler is switched off in every environment in the repo.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman sudah dibuat tapi scheduler-nya dimatikan di semua environment di repo.

steps.en: The message states the amount still owed, including any admin fee
steps.id: Pesan menyebut jumlah yang masih terutang, termasuk admin fee bila ada
steps.why_en: At the time of sending, the notice usually has no admin fee yet, so only the charge is stated.
steps.why_id: Saat dikirim, notice biasanya belum punya admin fee, jadi hanya jumlah denda yang disebut.
